notes.title: Banzai Run™ Released!
notes.content:
Banzai Run™ Pinball is available NOW on Steam, iOS, and Google Play!
https://youtu.be/yeue2-ZvxRw
Banzai Run™ (1988): is a unique classic table made by Williams. This was the first table designed by the legendary Pat Lawlor, with art by Mark Sprenger. Originally destined to be made as Wreck'n Ball, this table features a second Playfield built into the Backbox, the Banzai Hill Run. Run the Race and pass the other Riders to start Multiball and become the King of the Hill. Shoot the Ramp to score big by crossing the Finish Line. "Now, for the first time, there's a whole new direction for pinball. UP!" 1,751 units were produced.

notes.title: Spanish Eyes & Wild Card Pinball Just Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Double EM Pack: Spanish Eyes & Wild Card[/h1]
https://youtu.be/VhSKjBuvCyk?t=20s
[b]Spanish Eyes™ (1972)[/b]: is a distinctive table designed by Norm Clark with art drawn by John Craig. This fast-paced table is a unique design with a Bumper in between two widely spaced Flippers, making it an excellent game to practice nudging to keep the ball in play. Complete the letters A-B-C-D-E and 1-6 targets to build your score before shooting the valuable Center Loop and Saucer. But always keep your eyes open. Sharp reflexes lead to huge scores on Spanish Eyes. 3,905 units were produced. 

[b]Wild Card™ (1977)[/b]: was the last electro-mechanical single player game produced by Williams featuring art by Christian Marche. This table was built as a fitting end to the Williams EM era with "Wild Ball Action" feeding the wide range of shots that make this table engaging with every game played. Complete card sets to light Specials around the table and increase the value of the tough Upper Eject shot for big points. But don't forget to catch the valuable Left Lane rewards on each new ball to maximize your score. Put on your best poker face and play Wild Card. 901 units were produced.

notes.title: Ghostbusters™ Available NOW!
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/vVUjb5_Vnsc
Ghostbusters™ Premium (2016): highlights the humor of the original Ghostbusters film released in 1984. It was designed by John Trudeau to be easy to play but difficult to master. The distinctive playfield features beautiful and unique hand drawn art by renowned illustrator Jeremy Packer a.k.a. Zombie Yeti. It integrates traditional pinball devices with unique multifunction two-way ramps featuring a magnetic diverter and scoring switches. In addition, the game features a modern take on a ball transfer target, combative open field drop targets, a ball eject target, a captive ball target and custom molded toys. This table also features an interactive ghost hologram target with animations, "para-normal" magnetic action slingshots, distinctive ramp architecture and additional custom molded toys.

notes.title: Fireball™ and El Dorado™ Have Just Been Released!
notes.content:
Fireball™ and El Dorado™ have just been released!

Fireball™ (1972): is a highly collectable, fantasy themed pinball table that was designed by Ted Zale. This innovative game included ball saving features such as the Flipper-Zipper and a Kickback Kicker in the Left Outlane. The Flipper-Zipper moves the Flippers to block the center drain and the Kickback Kicker prevents balls from draining down the left Outlane. The middle of the playfield features a Whirlwind Spinner, which sends the ball flying in random directions. Locked ball bonuses and 2 and 3-Ball Multi-Ball put this game way ahead of its time. Fireball™ is a lightning storm of scoring action! 3,815 units of this table were produced.

Designed by Ed Krynski, the game features classic electro-mechanical gameplay with four flippers, two sets of Drop Targets and 10 Rollovers that can be lit for big points! 2,875 units of this table were produced.

notes.title: Safe Cracker™ Just Released!
notes.content:
We are very proud to announce that Safe Cracker™ has just been released!

Safe Cracker™ (1996): designed by Pat Lawlor, this unique table is noticeably shorter and more narrow than a standard pinball machine. Featuring timer based gameplay as opposed to having a certain number of balls, players take on the role of a bank robber looking to collect a stash. The goal during the pinball part of the game is to break into the bank. Once inside, the gameplay switches to an interactive board game on the back glass that must be played in order to break into the vault. This game also features Magic Tokens, which are dispensed as rewards from a special slot on the back glass. These tokens can be collected or used to start a separate game mode on the table called, Assault on the Vault. 1,148 units of this table were produced.

https://youtu.be/F6uAhSX8TTc

notes.title: Season 3 - Black Knight 2000™
notes.content:
Hey Pinball Fans! The third table of Season 3 is here! Pinball Arcade is proud to announce that Black Knight 2000™ is now available on Steam for Windows and Mac!

Black Knight 2000™ (1989): The Black Knight rides again in this brilliant sequel to the Steve Ritchie hit from 1980. Players take on the role of good versus evil as they battle the Black Knight in high velocity gameplay. The game is all about speed and quick reactions, highlighted by features such as an upper and lower level, repeating U-Turn and Skyway Loop shots rewarding accurate shooters and a Drawbridge that lowers to reveal a ramp. The patented Magna-Save™ feature from the original game is back. This allows players to activate a ball saving magnet preventing balls from draining. Great scores are achieved by collecting Lightning Wheel Awards, scoring Hurry-Up bonuses and playing the three awesome Multi-Ball rounds, including The King's Ransom Wizard mode. 5,703 units of this table were produced.

Check out the table in action!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/setaNqGilnk" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

notes.title: Season 3 - Black Rose Released!
notes.content:
Hey, Pinball Fans! Are you ready for the second table of Season 3? Pinball Arcade is proud to announce that Black Rose™ is now available on Steam for Windows and Mac!

Black Rose™ (1992): was designed by John Trudeau and Brian Eddy, who also worked together on the Williams' classic, The Machine: Bride of Pin-Bot™. This table gives you landlubbers the chance to live the life of a pirate on the high seas! Enter the Pirate's Cove for Multi-Ball and a chance to find hidden treasure, spiral your way to an extra ball on the Whirlpool ramp and collect torches, gun powder and cannon balls to open Davey Jones' Locker. Sink ships with the deadly accurate cannon that pops up from the playfield and fires pinballs. Three interactive video modes test your pirating skills to prove you're no scallywag. This game is loaded! 3,746 units of this classic table were produced.

notes.title: Fish Tales is now LIVE on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! As a little bit of an early present from FarSight to you, Pinball Arcade on Steam has Fish Tales™ available for download NOW instead of Friday! :) Hope you guys enjoy the table that's kicking off Season 3! (You might need to Log Out/Log In with Steam itself for the update to go through.)

Fish Tales™ (1992): is another great game by Mark Ritchie, Designer of other Williams classics such as Taxi™. Featuring a fishing theme, this table has many fun modes and features including a high scoring Multi-Ball mode and the challenge of catching Monster Fish! Unique features include a rotating Fishing Reel used to lock balls for Multi-Ball, a boat on the playfield with two ramps, a fishing rod shaped plunger control and an animated fish on the back box topper. The flippers on this table are 1/8 an inch shorter than the standard Williams flippers. Play Fish Tales to "Catch 'em all, hook line and sinker!" 13,640 units of this table were produced.

notes.title: Hello from FarSight!
notes.content:
Hey, Steam fans! We just wanted to make an official "first post" over here as our way of saying hi, and that we're going to be more active over here in the Community Hub, as well! How's everyone enjoying the game so far? Since release on PC, we've been having a ton of fun seeing people play the game, and this is only the beginning! [url=http://www.ign.com/articles/2013/11/19/pinball-arcade-review]IGN gave us an awesome review of 9.0, for the PC and PS4 version![/url]

"Ah," we hear you say, "about that PS4 version... why does it look better than the PC version?"  Not to worry, we have a long life of updates ahead of us for the PC version, and one of those includes a DirectX 11 update to bring the Steam version up to the lighting and graphics of the PS4!

[img]http://static.sendgrid.com/uploads/UID_773839_NL_1775431_e624bdf6a2d3d3a066d571655c19463c/2f5151dce45a22d7a4d96b6aad1f0d7e[/img]

Since our release on PC we've been astounded by the reception. We've released Portrait Mode (seen above), which we'll be continuing to expand on in the future! We've released Table Pack 20, our first Table Pack that we've released on PC in conjunction with all other platforms! That's the end of Season 2, folks... have you seen this hint for Season 3?

[img]http://static.sendgrid.com/uploads/UID_773839_NL_2305900_bf7ee18520668c39af00502c4f4caae0/85251c4e7732f319629ec0061d63792c[/img]

We think you guys are going to love what pinball tables we have coming at you next!

In the near future, we're going to begin streaming to our new Twitch channel at [url=http://www.twitch.tv/farsight_studios]www.twitch.tv/farsight_studios[/url], so give us a follow if you want, and we look forward to streaming and hanging out with you guys soon! Keep an eye on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/pinballarcade]Facebook page[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/PinballArcade]Twitter page[/url], as well!

If you have any questions or bugs that you're running into, we'll try to check here as much as possible, but we mainly look at the forums of PinballArcadeFans.com and to any emails sent to support@pinballarcade.com, so feel free to contact us there. Thank you guys so much for the support you've given us! Happy Flippin'!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Pinball Arcade
notes.content:
Pinball Arcade is Now Available on Steam! Download now and you’ll get the incredible Tales of the Arabian Nights™ table for free!

Pinball Arcade features exact recreations of the all-time greatest pinball tables from Williams®, Bally®, Stern Pinball®, and Gottlieb® together in one game. Every flipper, bumper, sound effect, and display pixel has been painstakingly emulated in astonishing detail.

In addition to Tales of the Arabian Nights, Twilight Zone™, Star Trek: The Next Generation™, Theatre of Magic™ (named the best video pinball simulation of all time by G4TV), Scared Stiff™, Elvira and the Party Monsters™, Monster Bash™, Gorgar™, Circus Voltaire™, Funhouse™, Medieval Madness™, Pin•Bot™, The Machine: Bride of Pin•Bot™, Creature from the Black Lagoon™, No Good Gofers™, Big Shot™, Taxi™, Harley-Davidson® 3rd Edition, Black Knight™, Cactus Canyon™, White Water™, Space Shuttle®, Centaur™, Flight 2000™, Goin’ Nuts™, Terminator 2: Judgment Day®, and other great tables are also available from within this great game.

Each month, regular updates will add classic pinball tables for years to come!
